name: digital_turbine-mcp
description: Digital Turbine (DT Ads) (ads): update_budget, pause_resume. Every tool maps to a documented endpoin

platform_mcp_digital_turbine_management_.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DIGITAL_TURBINE_MANAGEMENT_API_TOKEN
platform_mcp_digital_turbine_management_.description: Offerwall Advertiser Management API token (ACP Edge Console > Account > Security Tokens > Add Token > Management API Token; shown once), sent as the x-api-key header. It identifies the advertiser account.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: GraphQL mutation offerCampaignBulkUpdateBids {offerCmsId: campaign_id, bidsList: [{dailyBudget}]} sets the offer-level daily budget (a decimal string, account currency); this spends money. campaign_id is the offer's legacy CMS id shown under the product name in the ACP Edge dashboard. Rejected when country-level daily budgets are already configured ('A dailyBudget cannot be set for both the offer campaign and the country code simultaneously'). Validation failures come back in `errors` (non-empty = not applied). `currency` is ignored.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: GraphQL mutation offerCampaignBulkUpdateBids {offerCmsId: campaign_id, offerEnabled: false|true, bidsList: []} ('offerEnabled — Optional, boolean: true enables an offer; false, disables an offer'). bidsList is a required list and is sent empty so no bid or budget changes. campaign_id is the offer's legacy CMS id. Failures come back in `errors` (non-empty = not applied).
